Helpful Definitions

Learning Modes

  • Face-to-Face: Courses typically meet during weekdays on the UW–Madison campus.
  • Evening/weekend: Classes are held outside of regular business hours.
  • Online: Half or more of coursework is completed online.
  • Hybrid: Curricula combine on-campus and online formats.
  • Accelerated: Degrees are completed in a condensed timeframe.

Certificate Types

  • Graduate/Professional Certificates: Offering coordination among interrelated disciplines, these certificates are available to degree-seeking graduate and professional students.
  • Specialist Certificates: These represent work beyond the master's degree level.
  • Capstone Certificates: Available to applicants who are not enrolled in UW–Madison graduate programs, these professionally-focused experiences 'cap off' the undergraduate degree.
